description: Uncalibrated four-firm town; periods are not calendar years.

half_time_smooth.label: Half the paid time, shared evenly every round

half_time_rotating.label: Half the paid time, rotating who is on duty

myopic_layoff_smallstep.label: Whole jobs; a cautious 10% adoption step

myopic_protected.label: Firms choose whether to adopt; protected pay

myopic_hourly.label: Firms choose whether to adopt; hourly pay

myopic_free_ai.label: Firms choose whether to adopt; free AI and protected pay

myopic_expensive_ai.label: Firms choose whether to adopt; expensive AI

protected_redeploy.label: Both adopt gradually; protect pay, expand capacity

protected_time.label: Both adopt; same pay, shorter contracted hours

hourly_time.label: Both adopt; shorter hours, hourly pay

layoffs.label: Both adopt; six jobs instead of ten

one_full_rigid.label: One shop fully automates; rival keeps its payroll

one_full_flexible.label: One shop fully automates; rival adjusts paid hours to sales

myopic_flexible.label: Firms choose adoption and adjust paid hours to sales

one_hourly.label: One adopts; its paid hours fall

staggered.label: The rival adopts ten rounds later

sudden.label: Both jump directly to 40% task automation

full_price_cuts.label: All normal cost savings pass into prices

expensive_ai.label: AI task-hour fee rises from 3 to 9

scarce_ai.label: AI can supply only three task-hours per round

no_spare_equipment.label: Consumer equipment starts with no spare capacity

full_automation_hourly.label: Gradually automate all tasks; hourly pay disappears

full_automation_redeploy.label: No workers; deploy all available machine capacity

full_automation_protected.label: Automate all tasks but continue salary payments

owners_spend_all.label: Owners spend all dividends, after equipment funding

sales_responsive.label: Equipment orders follow last round's sales

shared_ownership.label: Workers receive 60% of all cash dividends

shared_ownership_expand.label: No jobs; gifted dividend rights and ample AI capacity

full_automation_ample_ai.label: No jobs; ample AI capacity, owners receive dividends
